Prior to November 2012, data were obtained from Ministry of Community Development, Youth and Sports.  With effect from November 2012, data were obtained from Ministry of Social and Family Development.  Welfare homes cater for the care and rehabilitation of male and female destitute persons, and are established under the Destitute Persons Act.  Data include only those aged 60 years and above.  Woodlands Home for the Aged was closed in May 1997.  From 1997 onwards, figures refer to Pelangi Home and Woody Lodge.
